say:0:1660207001:2.text: The cold rain silences the distant music. Melancholy and sorrow slither through the woods like vipers, coiling tighter with every breath, pulling all into the mire.

say:4:1660207004:0.text: Hold on, can someone please explain why the palace looks like this?
say:4:1660207004:0.source_cn: 停一停，有谁来告诉我，宫殿里为什么会变成这个样子？

say:8:1660207006:0.text: Ludovic slowly opens his eyes and lets out a long sigh.
say:8:1660207006:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔睁开双眼，长长地悲叹一声。

say:9:1660207007:0.text: Lyca, why bother asking at all? You already know... everything that's happened here, I commanded it.
say:9:1660207007:0.source_cn: 莱卡巡游长，你何必去问他们呢。你应知道，这一切，都是我...

say:10:1660207008:0.text: Then tell me, my lord... what exactly is it you're trying to do?
say:10:1660207008:0.source_cn: 那么，领主大人，您这又是在做什么呢？

say:11:1660207009:1.text: Life slips away like water through fingers. Why struggle against it, only to suffer more? Isn't it better to surrender, calmly, and accept the end?
say:11:1660207009:1.source_cn: 生命如流水一样消逝，又有谁能够阻止？与其为了求生，承受...

say:12:1660207010:1.text: You must know that the realm of spring is barely holding on. Everyone is looking to you for strength, for guidance.
say:12:1660207010:1.source_cn: 您应该知道，春之国的情况并不乐观，所有人都在指望您的智...

say:13:1660207011:0.text: I know. I know it all too well. But now I, too, bear the spring curse. I can't lift the pain from our people. Worse yet, I've become a burden to you... I no longer have the strength to fight this.
say:13:1660207011:0.source_cn: 我知道，我都知道。可是如今我也染上了这春日诅咒。既无法...

say:14:1660207012:0.text: When living becomes nothing but endless suffering, death feels like the only way out.
say:14:1660207012:0.source_cn: 当活着已是一种无法摆脱的痛苦，死亡便顺理成章地成为了最...

say:15:1660207013:1.text: My lord, please, don't give up now. We can still find a way to cure the spring curse!
say:15:1660207013:1.source_cn: 领主大人，请您振作起来，我们一定能找到消除春日诅咒的方法的！

say:16:1660207014:0.text: Life always ends in death. But death—true, final death—can end all pain. The spring curse can't be cured. Death is the only release.

say:19:1660207016:1.text: You realize the spring curse works exactly as Ludovic described—it amplifies the melancholy and dark thoughts already in a person's heart.
say:19:1660207016:1.source_cn: 你意识到，春日诅咒果然像柳博米尔所说的那样，会放大人心...

say:20:1660207017:1.text: It's gotten to him. He'd once given up on chasing death... and now that dark thought is creeping back into his heart.
say:20:1660207017:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔正是受到了这种影响，让本已不再追求“彻底死亡”...

say:21:1660207018:1.text: You think back to that scene in the play, where the great hero Merlin sang the curse away. Maybe it was fiction, but right now, it's your only lead. So you lean toward Lyca and share your idea.
